title: Reconstruction of ARNT PAS-B Unfolding Pathways by Steered Molecular Dynamics and Artificial Neural Networks.
authors: Motta, Stefano; Pandini, Alessandro; Fornili, Arianna; Bonati, Laura
journal: Journal of chemical theory and computation
one_liner_zh: 该文用定向分子动力学模拟结合自组织映射神经网络重建ARNT PAS-B结构域的解折叠路径，虽涉及转录因子结构域构象变化，但核心是蛋白质结构域解折叠机制而非TF-DNA结合互作，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA动态研究。
abstract: Several experimental studies indicated that large conformational changes, including partial domain unfolding, have a role in the functional mechanisms of the basic helix loop helix Per/ARNT/SIM (bHLH-PAS) transcription factors. Recently, single-molecule atomic force microscopy (AFM) revealed two distinct pathways for the mechanical unfolding of the ARNT PAS-B. In this work we used steered molecular dynamics simulations to gain new insights into this process at an atomistic level. To reconstruct and classify pathways sampled in multiple simulations, we designed an original approach based on the use of self-organizing maps (SOMs). This led us to identify two types of unfolding pathways for the ARNT PAS-B, which are in good agreement with the AFM findings. Analysis of average forces mapped on the SOM revealed a stable conformation of the PAS-B along one pathway, which represents a possible structural model for the intermediate state detected by AFM. The approach here proposed will facilitate the study of other signal transmission mechanisms involving the folding/unfolding of PAS domains.
abstract_zh: 多项实验研究表明，大的构象变化，包括部分结构域解折叠，在基本螺旋-环-螺旋Per/ARNT/SIM（bHLH-PAS）转录因子的功能机制中发挥作用。近期，单分子原子力显微镜（AFM）揭示了ARNT PAS-B机械解折叠的两条不同路径。在本工作中，我们采用受控分子动力学模拟，以在原子层面获得对这一过程的新见解。为了重建并分类多次模拟中采样的路径，我们设计了一种基于自组织映射（SOMs）的原创方法。这使我们识别出ARNT PAS-B的两种解折叠路径，与AFM发现高度一致。对映射到SOM上的平均力的分析揭示，沿一条路径PAS-B存在稳定构象，这可能是AFM检测到的中间状态的结构模型。本文提出的方法将有助于研究涉及PAS结构域折叠/解折叠的其他信号传导机制。
